title: Monoshrum
description: This mod adds a dimension called "Monoshrum". Also this mod has Turkish and English language support.
body:
**First of all thank you for looking this mod.**

Monoshrum is a adventure mod that adds a dimension called "Monoshrum". Monoshrum contains numerous fungal spores, lichens, mushrooms, and mushroom-like plants.**(Not added fully now.)** This means that Monoshrum has a **spore-rich atmosphere**. It can be **dangerous** sometimes. At the moment Monoshrum has 1 biome; **Monoshrum Plains**. Monoshrum Plains has glower, greenshroom and galaspore as plants.

> **It's all for now but this mod will be updated frequently.**
> **Monoshrum is in Alpha.**
